BLOCKER: empty_delta_rule excludes `data/backlog/**`, but item ACs, risk_tier, enforce flags, and design_pack live in backlog data; editing those via the data path keeps the review-relevant diff empty, so stale evidence "passes" while policy content changed — classify by content class (item AC/policy fields), not just path.

Design-pack validation is implied in both `gate1_check.py` and `precheck.py`; if each implements its own section/schema checks the gates will diverge. The design must mandate a single shared validator (design_pack.py) as the only enforcement path, with both gates calling it.

No invariant/test asserts delta-base continuity (prior evidence head_sha == next base_sha, or explicit gap handling); without it, out-of-order or deleted evidence silently degrades a re-review to a partial diff. Add invariant + fail-able test.
MAJOR: evidence_compat relies on "latest at" wall-clock tie-break with no stated atomic write (temp+rename) or monotonic ordering; under the single-writer assumption this is untested — specify write protocol and an ordering test.
Empty-delta path (exit 0, no evidence written) is absent from the test_matrix; the no-model-call, last-reviewed-head-preserving behavior is the highest-risk shortcut and must be fail-ably tested.

Redaction says "reason text is redacted" but prior findings are replayed to the reviewer — state exactly which prior-disposition content is retained vs redacted, else re-reviews lose disambiguation context and auditability degrades.

Rollback claims "generated design MDs deleted" without stating whether `engineering/design/<ID>.md` is committed or ignored; if committed, reverting the generator orphans MDs. Specify artifact lifecycle (gitignore vs committed + cleanup step).
MINOR: Encoding gate should define byte-level BOM detection (EF BB BF pre-decode) and explicit binary/asset skip rules; decode-based detection misreports UTF-16 and creates false positives the risks already flag.

Excluded-path set (derived docs, baselines, id-blocks) should live in versioned config with a rationale per entry, not hardcoded, so future "derived" classification changes are reviewable and testable.
Observability lists "final report gate metrics" and "stderr/exit codes" but names no fields/events; specify a minimal stable event schema (item, mode, base, head, diff_sha, outcome, failure_code).
No test named for DELTA_BASE_INVALID / DESIGN_PACK_CONFIG / ENCODING_BOM in test_matrix (only three files listed); the failure matrix implies more coverage than the matrix commits to.
Provider findings stored in evidence have no retention/redaction policy for source-excerpt leakage; state scope (metadata+text classification) and retention for evidence files.
NIT: Recurring: "collisions resolve by latest at" still uses wall-clock nanos; prefer diff_sha-keyed uniqueness only and drop time-based resolution.
enforce_items/enforce_from rollout ("T1 applies to 1484/1485 only") should include a golden test asserting the config matches the intended item set to prevent accidental broad enforcement.
Generated design MD check should include a render-drift assertion (re-render and diff) so hand-edited generated files fail fast.
SUMMARY: Solid, well-scoped tooling-only change with clear invariants, failure codes, and guardrail coverage; language rule and authz/tenant N/A are correctly handled.

Top risks: the path-based empty-delta exclusion lets item AC/policy edits bypass re-review; design-pack validation must be single-sourced across Gate 1 and precheck; delta-base continuity is unasserted.
Address the three blockers and add empty-delta + failure-code tests before Gate 1.5; remaining items are hardening.
